code='''def transform(grid):
    # Puzzle-specific arrangement: closed rectangular frames go at the top; other objects go at the bottom.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); objs=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color=grid[r][c]
            if color==0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]==color and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
            y0=min(y for y,x in cells); y1=max(y for y,x in cells); x0=min(x for y,x in cells); x1=max(x for y,x in cells)
            local={(y-y0,x-x0) for y,x in cells}; oh=y1-y0+1; ow=x1-x0+1
            frame=(oh>=3 and ow>=3 and all((y,x) in local for y in (0,oh-1) for x in range(ow)) and all((y,x) in local for x in (0,ow-1) for y in range(oh)) and len(local)<oh*ow)
            objs.append((color,cells,y0,x0,oh,frame))
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for color,cells,y0,x0,oh,frame in objs:
        dy=0 if frame else h-oh-y0
        for y,x in cells: out[y+dy][x]=color
    return out
'''
